subject: 北京真觉寺金刚宝座 · 南面五层佛龛与密檐石塔
author: ScareCriterion12
source_note: 以2024年北京真觉寺南面实拍为主体，放大同一照片核对五排佛龛和下方独立的动物花卉雕刻带。正面视角中后排两角塔被遮挡，保留可见的三塔投影及琉璃小殿。排除同名呼和浩特五塔寺的照片，未作生成输入。
prompt: Create one black-on-white fine architectural line plate of the FRONT of the Beijing Zhenjue Temple Diamond Throne Stupa. Image1 is line STYLE ONLY. Image2 is the actual front photo, Image3 is a crop of the same front photo to make the exact relief-band count unmistakable. Copy this building, not a generic five-pagoda temple. Draw the broad vajra-throne platform with SIX ornamental bands total, from top to bottom: Band1 Buddha niches, Band2 Buddha niches, Band3 Buddha niches, Band4 Buddha niches, Band5 Buddha niches, Band6 animal/floral carvings. There must be FIVE visible stacked rows of Buddha-niche carvings, and a separate sixth animal/floral band under all five. Thin projecting stone cornices separate these six bands. The main arched doorway passes through Band4, Band5 and Band6 ONLY. Band1,2,3 must remain uninterrupted horizontal niche rows above the doorway. This six-band counting is the most important geometric requirement. Above the platform draw exactly the visible front photo arrangement: two side stone dense-eave pagodas and the partly hidden central stone pagoda, with stone finials, plus the little front access chamber and its green-glazed square-lower-eave/round-conical-upper-roof pavilion outlined without color. Leave the rear pair of corner pagodas hidden as in this exact frontal photograph; do not invent five towers spread in a line. Complete monument, short central steps, all base and finials uncut; fit inside a landscape1536x1024 canvas with white breathing room, approximately straight-on, verticals vertical. Refined sparse thin BLACK contours, Buddha niches indicated with only a few tiny outlines. Uniform opaque PURE WHITE #FFFFFF everywhere other than ink, including windows and doors. No shadows, solid black areas, gray fill, hatching, texture, paper grain, color, checkerboard, lettering, captions, frame, watermark or background objects. Remove all trees, lions, incense burner, benches, ropes, signs, neighboring structures and people.

generation_history.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one fine architectural illustration for the heritage collection 访古. Image1 is the Longmen LINE STYLE MASTER ONLY. Image2 is the actual FRONT of the Diamond Throne Stupa at Beijing Zhenjue Temple, photographed in2024: this is the geometry and viewpoint master. Image3 is its REAR, provided only to confirm the five horizontal relief bands and stone pagoda geometry; never substitute the rear facade. Draw the complete FRONT exactly as Image2 but unobstructed, approximately straight-on with verticals vertical and modest perspective. Broad rectangular five-tier stone vajra-throne platform, with exactly five horizontal rows of small Buddha niches separated by thin projecting cornices; central semicircular arched doorway with outlined timber lattice doors, carved base relief and short stone stairs. Above stands a rectangular roof-access chamber with an arched opening and the recognizable glazed two-level pavilion roof: lower square eaves and upper round conical roof. Behind and beside it are the stone dense-eave pagodas: actual ensemble has one central thirteen-eave pagoda and four eleven-eave corner pagodas, but in this frontal view only the three aligned tower silhouettes and any tiny rear portions actually visible should be shown. Do not spread five towers in a row, invent extra tower silhouettes, or mistake it for the Hohhot Five Pagoda Temple. The central tower remains partly hidden behind the glazed pavilion; use actual photo positions and apex heights. Indicate Buddha relief niches with a few delicate contours, not a dense wall of detailed figures. No filled black doorway or windows. Fine sparse BLACK INK contours on perfectly flat opaque pure white #FFFFFF; all non-ink areas inside and outside pure white. No gray shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, color, gold, shadow, gradient or glow. Landscape1536x1024, complete complex centered and about82% of width, all finials and base uncut, balanced margins. Remove trees, branches, benches, visitors, freestanding lions, incense burner, signs, ropes, lamps, neighboring buildings and sky. No lettering, labels, captions, frame, checkerboard or watermark.
